entry.description: The component's path under `ngwr/`, nested ones included — e.g. `button`, `select`, `charts/bar-chart`.

path.description: Folder the copy is written to, from the workspace root. Defaults to `src/app/ngwr/<entry>`.

from.description: A local checkout of the ngwr repository (its root, or its `projects/lib`) to copy from, instead of fetching the sources of the installed version from GitHub.
